guide.summary: Wawel, the Market Square museums, Kazimierz and the Wieliczka mine, with restaurants, breakfast cafés and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan museum days around closures: the National Museum and Manggha shut on Mondays, MOCAK opens only Thursday to Sunday, and the Eagle Pharmacy is closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The National Museum's Main Building and Czartoryski Museum and the Manggha Museum close on Mondays. MOCAK opens Thursday to Sunday only, and the Eagle Pharmacy is closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Free days
toolkit.copy: Tuesday is free for the National Museum's permanent exhibitions, Manggha and Rynek Underground; Monday is free at Schindler's Factory and the Town Hall Tower, and Wednesday at the Eagle Pharmacy. Museum of Krakow free tickets are sold only at the box office on the day.

toolkit.label: Timed tickets
toolkit.copy: Oskar Schindler's Enamel Factory sells online tickets 90 days ahead, stops online sales 6 hours before a visit, and asks for original ID with personal tickets. Its ticket office sells only same-day tickets for the next available slot, up to 5 per person.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: St. Mary's Bugle Tower is closed November to April, sells tickets only on the day, and does not admit children under 8. Mercy Brown admits adults only, and Charlotte takes walk-ins without reservations until 16:00.

guide.dek: Book Schindler's Factory and Wawel ahead, then fit the smaller museums around their closing and free days.
intro: Wawel Royal Castle is at its most generous in November: its "Free November 2026" campaign gives you free passes to the free exhibitions, collected at the ticket offices or online up to a week ahead, with up to 5 tickets per person. During the month the State Rooms and Castle Underground open Tuesday to Sunday from 9:00 to 17:00, while Mondays open only the first-floor Royal Private Apartments, from 10:00 to 16:00. The temporary exhibition "Lares and penates", on security in architecture, runs until 6 January 2027. Groups must book guided tours in advance.

On the Main Market Square, Rynek Underground at Rynek Główny 1 opens until 20:00 from Friday to Sunday and closes on the second Monday of the month; Tuesday entry is free but sold only at the box office on the day. The Town Hall Tower opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00. At St. Mary's Basilica, visiting runs from 11:30 on weekdays and 14:00 on Sundays, and the Veit Stoss altar opens at 11:50 on weekdays. Its Bugle Tower is closed from November to April.

Across the river, Oskar Schindler's Enamel Factory on Lipowa Street opens until 20:00 from Tuesday to Sunday and closes on the first Tuesday of the month. Online tickets go on sale 90 days ahead, and a Schindler ticket also gets you into the Eagle Pharmacy within 7 days. MOCAK, next door, opens Thursday to Sunday and shows Eleanor Antin's retrospective from 5 December 2026 to 21 March 2027. The National Museum's Main Building has "Citizen Cepelia" until 21 February 2027 and "The Faces of Czapski" until 31 January 2027.

For meals, Charlotte on Plac Szczepański bakes its own bread in the basement, serves breakfast until closing and takes walk-ins until 16:00. Starka in Kazimierz holds booked tables for 15 minutes, and Wierzynek on the square closes on Mondays. For a later evening, Mercy Brown on Straszewskiego has no sign on the door, admits adults only and hosts mostly free live music, while Alchemia on Plac Nowy runs a busy concert programme. At Wieliczka the Tourist Route is open 09:00 to 17:00 and takes 2 to 3 hours.
summaryCards: Pair Wawel Royal Castle in the morning with St. Mary's Basilica and Rynek Underground on the Market Square in the afternoon.
Start with breakfast at Charlotte on Plac Szczepański, then browse Stary Kleparz, which trades Monday to Saturday.
Reserve Schindler's Factory online up to 90 days ahead, and check each museum's closing and free days before you fix your route.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability, and seasonal or holiday hours may differ from the weekly hours quoted. Several sites could not be read because of certificate or SSL errors, 403 responses, DNS failures or redirects to social media (including Kraków Zoo, Massolit, Café Noworolski, Hamsa, Hotel Stary, Pochlebstwo, Zmączeni, Bottiglieria 1881 and Karma Coffee), so those places were left out rather than treated as closed. Opening hours were not published on the pages read for Starka, Szara Gęś, Pimiento (Stolarska), Alchemia and Wesoła Café, and Stary Kleparz gives days but not times. Wieliczka Salt Mine, Pod Aniołami and several restaurants were confirmed from current hours, menus or booking pages without an explicitly dated 2026 notice. The Wawel hours quoted apply to November 2026.
injectionLikeTextIgnored: WebFetch summaries for kopieckosciuszki.pl and galiciajewishmuseum.org said the page 'included an instruction to quote any text addressed to an AI'. That wording matches the fetch prompt itself, and neither summary quoted page text, so it was treated as a false flag. Not verified in a browser.
2026-10-25: both pages were opened in a browser and their full HTML searched; no AI-directed text was present.
